text:
Courtney (Sales AE): Heads up — Prospect 'GreenAxis' just asked for our compliance pack for the POC. They want SOC 2 artifacts, a recent vulnerability assessment attestation, and confirmation on dedicated pricing timeline.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Can you paste the exact list they sent? want to check if on-prem infra docs are needed.
Courtney (Sales AE): Sure — their email says:
- SOC 2 Type II report or bridge letter
- Vulnerability assessment attestation (third-party/red-team ok)
- Network diagram for dedicated deployment
- Timeline on dedicated capacity provisioning (estimates)
- Proof of encryption key management (KMS/HSM)
Diego (Solutions Eng): Got it. For network diagram I can generate the dedicated-VPC sketch. ETA end of day tomorrow.
Priya (Security): For the vulnerability attestation: we have a 2024 third-party assessment PDF and an internal remediation summary. We don't currently provide signed attestation templates to customers by default. Do they need a signature from our CISO/legal?
Courtney (Sales AE): They specifically said "signed confirmation that a third-party vuln assessment was completed within last 12 months" and they'd prefer a short one-page attestation letter.
Marcus (Legal): We can provide a one-page attestation. Need to confirm scope wording. Marcus: draft language suggestion: "Redwood Inference engaged [Assessor] to perform a technical vulnerability assessment on [date range]. Findings were evaluated and remediations tracked." Want me to draft?
Priya (Security): Please include scope (external/internal, authenticated), assessor name, and a high-level summary of findings + remediation status. No raw vuln data.
Olivia (Customer Success): Also flag that the customer asked for a pen-test follow-up question: do we permit them to run their own security scan during the POC? Answer is usually yes under NDA with scoped IPs.
Courtney (Sales AE): GreenAxis wants to start POC next week. They asked for all artifacts before kickoff. Is that feasible?
Diego (Solutions Eng): Network diagram + provisioning timeline: I can confirm dedicated capacity ETA: 2 weeks after signed commitment for standard reqs; 4 weeks if they require specific region HW. I can provide that as a short bulleted schedule.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare the attestation draft and the remediation summary (redacted). Marcus — please review for legal sign-off.
Marcus (Legal): Will review. If you can put the draft in a shared folder I can sign electronically (DocuSign) once reviewed.
AuditBot: New evidence request logged: https://redwood.internal/audit/requests/GA-2026-042 (assigned to Priya, due 2026-03-28) :memo:
Courtney (Sales AE): I'll reply to GreenAxis with an ask: confirm who at their side will sign NDA (if they plan to run scans), and give them a Dropbox link for the artifacts.
Courtney (Sales AE): Action items:
- Priya: draft vuln attestation + remediation summary (by EOD today)
- Diego: VPC & dedicated deployment diagram + provisioning timeline (tomorrow)
- Marcus: legal review and sign-off on attestation (ASAP)
- Courtney: request NDA signer and upload link to customer (today)
Olivia (Customer Success): I'll prep the POC runbook so we can include scan rules and contact points if they run any tests.
Diego (Solutions Eng): FYI sample snippet for the network diagram I'll include:
```
VPC: gw-redwood-dedicated
Subnets: public-app, private-infer
Ingress: LB -> public-app
Egress: NAT -> private-infer
KMS: customer-managed key (optional)
```
Priya (Security): One more thing — if they request an HSM attestation, we'll need to schedule a short call with our infra team to confirm key custody model.
Courtney (Sales AE): Good call. I'll note that in the customer reply.
Marcus (Legal): Once Priya drops the draft, I can approve and sign. If GreenAxis needs a notarized letter that's extra legal overhead — flagging now.
Courtney (Sales AE): Thanks team. I'll send the initial reply now and loop in the customer's security lead. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
